facts.text: Kyiv death and injury toll from the Oct. 13-14 Russian strike (rising to five killed, 36 injured per Kyiv police)
Ballistic missile hit Darnytska CHP-4 power plant supplying Kyiv heat and electricity, per Zelenskyy
At least 600,000 people across Ukraine left without electricity after overnight strikes
Desnianskyi high-rise hit: 21 injured including a child, 16 residents rescued, 400 sq m fire
Desnianskyi district administration: 17 injured, two dead, 14 buildings damaged as of 09:00 Oct. 14
Oct. 15 Pechersk drone crash injured seven, three hospitalized, per Klitschko
Air Force: Russia launched 580 drones overnight, 536 neutralized
Nationwide toll from drone waves across Ukraine (rising to at least 17 killed, 67 injured)
Russia says its strikes hit communications and energy facilities used by Ukraine's military and downed 900 drones
Russia accuses Ukraine of attacking Saratov and Ryazan refineries in breach of energy ceasefire; Kyiv calls claim fake
SpaceX Starlink 160 km/h speed limit disrupted Ukrainian drone operations, per Beskrestnov
No consolidated Kyiv casualty figure covering both the Oct. 13-14 and Oct. 15 strikes
Three women aged 35, 58 and 84 killed in Desnianskyi block, 25 injured there; two killed in Holosiivskyi
Prosecutor's Office as of 08:50 Oct. 14: three women killed, 19 injured in Desnianskyi incl. seven-year-old girl
Klitschko Oct. 14: at least three killed, 22 injured
Nationwide toll from Oct. 14 strikes (at least nine killed, later 10 killed and 91 injured)
Desnianskyi injured counts differ between district admin, SES and mayor (17/21/22), not reconciled
No deaths reported in the Oct. 15 Pechersk drone strike
Zelenskyy says Russia is defying Trump's energy ceasefire
Kyiv police: Oct. 15 Pechersk drone crash injured six by 12:10 p.m., four hospitalized
Kyiv City Prosecutor's Office Oct. 14: at least four killed, 25 injured in capital
Prosecutor's four killed/25 injured figure below police five/36 and not reconciled

missed.text: Strikes came days after Trump announced an "energy ceasefire"; Zelenskyy accused Moscow of "ostentatious disrespect" toward the US
Kirovohrad Oblast hit by its largest attack of the war: three killed, six injured in Kropyvnytskyi, per governor Andrii Raikovych
Lutsk warehouse strike killed six and injured 12, per Volyn governor Roman Romaniuk
Other Kyiv districts hit Oct. 13-14: Dniprovskyi, Darnytskyi, Shevchenkivskyi, and Holosiivskyi (one killed, one injured)
Not established whether the energy ceasefire is still nominally in force; both sides allege violations
Kyiv police have received about 80 damage claims at a mobile tent in Desnianskyi
